mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_schedule(id, name, t_group, expression, status, is_info, classname, task_id, description, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}, #{tGroup}, #{expression}, #{status}, #{isInfo}, #{classname}, #{taskId}, #{description}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, '0')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_schedule WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_date DESC
SELECT * FROM sys_schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_schedule WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_schedule SET del_flag = '1', update_date = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
